title: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.29 does not prevent users with…
description: The Kali Forms WordPress plugin before version 2.4.29 allows users with author-level access and above to inject arbitrary JavaScript into form button configurations. This JavaScript executes in the browser session of any user who clicks the button, including administrators, potentially leading to cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
